distributedAssetValue.tooltip: Value of tokenized real-world assets that can move to external wallets and between eligible wallets. KYC or allowlist requirements may still apply.

representedAssetValue.tooltip: Value of tokenized real-world assets confined to the issuer’s platform. These tokens cannot move to external wallets or transfer between wallets.

value_invariant: All source snapshot values and 30-day changes remain unchanged.
